place.title: Today's air for your place
place.lede: The official air reading for your place, and a plan for your household's day. Every figure shows its working.
place.heading: Your place
place.label: City, town or PIN code
place.asking: Asking the browser for your location
place.rounded: From this device, rounded to about a kilometre before it is used.
place.blank: Type a city, town or PIN code first.

denied.title: Location is turned off for this site
denied.body: Type your city, town or PIN code instead. To allow location later, open the site settings from the icon beside the address bar.

unavailable.title: Your location could not be found
unavailable.body: Type your city, town or PIN code instead.

outside.title: This location is outside India
outside.body: Readings here cover places in India. Type a city, town or PIN code in India.

pin.hint: Check the six digits, or type the town.

name.hint: Check the spelling, or try a PIN code.

place.exactNote: Approximate centre of the PIN area, used only to find the nearest monitoring station.
place.prefixNote: This PIN is not in the table, so this is the approximate centre of the {pins} known PINs starting {prefix}, most within {km} km of it, used only to find the nearest monitoring station. Your town name gives a closer match.

air.heading: Today's air

start.title: Start with your place
start.body: The air card shows the reading from the nearest CPCB station. If none is within {radius} km, it shows a model estimate and says so.

air.aqiGloss: AQI is the air quality index CPCB publishes, from 0 to 500. PM2.5 is fine dust.
air.subNote: CPCB hourly sub-index, not the AQI.

noHourly.cpcb_feed: CPCB published no hourly sub-index for this station.
noHourly.data_gov_in: This source gives averages only, so no hourly sub-index is shown.

air.ozonePeak: Ozone, highest hour of the last 8
air.down: The station data is not current
air.modelledLabel: Modelled estimate from CAMS via Open-Meteo. Not a measurement. It tends to read low in cities.
air.modelNote: Trailing 24 hour means in µg/m³. Ozone and CO are 8 hour means, CO in mg/m³. Where ozone is marked as its highest hour, that hour is used instead of the mean.
air.insufficient: The model gave too few pollutants for an index, so none is shown.
air.unavailable: The air reading could not be fetched
air.staleBody: It is for {hour}, {age} ago. CPCB has not published a newer one. The plan treats it as old.

feedProblem.updating: The station data is being updated at the source. Try again in a minute.
feedProblem.busy: The station data source is busy. Try again in a minute.
feedProblem.no_answer: The station data source did not answer. Try again in a minute.
feedProblem.unusable: The station data source sent something this app could not read. Try again later.

cpcb_feed.short: CPCB published no AQI for this station this hour.
cpcb_feed.note: This app shows CPCB's AQI as published and never works one out for a station.

data_gov_in.short: No AQI for this station this hour.
data_gov_in.note: CPCB's rule needs at least three pollutants, one of them PM2.5 or PM10, and this station has fewer this hour.

grapStages.none: No GRAP stage is in force
grapStages.II: Stages I and II are in force
grapStages.III: Stages I to III are in force
grapStages.IV: Stages I to IV are in force

modelledWhy.feed_unavailable: {problem} No earlier reading is saved for this place.
modelledWhy.no_station_reading: No CPCB station within {radius} km published a reading this hour.

unavailableWhy.feed_and_model_down: {problem} The model did not answer either, and no earlier reading is saved.
unavailableWhy.no_station_and_model_down: No CPCB station is within {radius} km, and the model did not answer.
